volTreatments.label: Mean + 3SD cap (S0.90 fence)
volTreatments.note: Deliverable method. Outliers identified on S0.90 stage 3+4 — the field that weights the shares — per indication, union across all three. Values above the retained-sample mean+3SD are capped at it; others stand as reported. Nobody is excluded, so the base is the full non-global-OL sample.

volTreatments.label: Exclude outliers (legacy)
volTreatments.note: The previous Gyn deliverable. Respondents past the (IQR + Mean+2SD)/2 midpoint fence on S0.80 total patient volume are dropped from the base entirely.

volTreatments.label: Mean + 3SD cap (S0.80 fence)
volTreatments.note: Same cap, but outliers identified on S0.80 total patient volume — 'large practice' rather than 'high leverage on this metric'. Kept for comparison.
